# Image File

## Contract
`ImageDef` is the FileDef specialization for image files: an uploaded realm
file with image-aware rendering (dimension-aware fitted/embedded formats).

Invariants:
- Fitted format FILLS its container; embedded letterboxes — pick the
  format for the layout you need.
- Instances are realm files with card semantics; the binary lives at the
  file URL, the card carries metadata.

## Example
```ts
import { ImageDef, createFileDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/card-api';

@field productPhoto = linksTo(ImageDef);
```
Fitted format fills its container; embedded letterboxes — pick per layout.
